text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with Machikane Tannhauser,
she suddenly stopped in her tracks...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I thoroughly enjoyed my time off! Thank you very much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...So, do you have any plans after this?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Really!
Then let's head to the shopping district!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Look, you know what this is!
You're invited on a special 'hospitality' tour!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Carried along by her invitation, I arrived
at the shopping district with Matikanetannhauser."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I'd love to go to that shop over there!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Taiyaki, taiyaki~♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look!
It says "Now with 30% more bean paste!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Not 30% off, but 30% extra!
I have no choice but to buy it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Hmm?
That's weird...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...I might have forgotten my wallet.
Uuu, my taiyaki...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?! Yay, yaaay!
You're even more generous than a giant taiyaki!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, well then, time to dig i~n!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hafu, hafu! *munch*!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Sooo hawwt!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KABLAMMOOO~)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Startled by the heat, Matikanetannhauser fell squarely on her backside...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ow, ow, ouch.
Phew~, that really startled me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I agree!
Let's pawn over to the park!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...By the time we finished eating taiyaki at the park,
the sun had completely begun to set.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wonder when Machikane Tannhauser's
"hospitality" is going to start...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the taiyaki.
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Shall we head back before it gets dark?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, surprising, isn't it?
Even though it's a "Hospitality Tour,"
we really just strolled through the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Still, this is my brand of "hospitality"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm just totally, utterly ordinary,
without anything special going for me, and yet..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Trainer scouted me just the way I am, so I figured being my normal self would be best.
choice_data_list: That might very well be true.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Besides... special days are fun, but I really love ordinary, everyday life!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So today, I'm sticking to ordinary as best!
Hooray for ordinary!
choice_data_list: That was wonderful hospitality, so like you.
That was such wonderful hospitality, so typical of you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So today, I'm sticking to ordinary as best!
Hooray for ordinary!
choice_data_list: That was wonderful hospitality, so like you.
That was such wonderful hospitality, so typical of you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, to hear you say that much!
I'm so happy and surprised!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I ought to offer
even greater hospitality...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, that was way out of my league, wasn't it?
Ahaha~

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So, please continue to take care of the ordinary me!
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, I was thinking the exact same thing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I'm with you, Trainer,
even the most ordinary days feel so thrilling!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it... It's like ordinary things
become an even better kind of ordinary!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, let's keep having
thrilling and exciting times together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So today marks our staying-the-same anniversary... Hehehe, I feel like making a toast~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, but we don't have any drinks.
Oops~ I did it again, didn't I?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
In that case... let's do an air toast!
Fists together—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Cheeeers~~!
